messages.subject: Re: open issues — our instructions
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Daniel and I have read your issues note. We're comfortable conceding the cap to 125% provided LDs stay within it and the consequential-loss exclusion holds. Hold the 15% shortfall — that protects our capacity investment. The 4% price cap is acceptable. We're fine on the convenience right after year two.

Go and land it.

Rebecca
